symptom: `return $Nope + 1;` with `$Nope` defined nowhere passed `mxcli check -p` and `exec`, then MxBuild reported CE0109 "Undefined variable 'Nope'" at the End event.
file: mdl/executor/validate_undefined_variable.go (MDL098: initDefinedVariables, checkUndefinedVariables, implicitVariables), hooked into checkExprFunctions in validate_microflow.go and initialised in validate() and validateNanoflowWith; mdl/exprcheck/variable_refs.go VariableReferences. Tests: validate_undefined_variable_test.go, variable_refs_test.go
cause: Nothing compared the `$name`s an expression reads with the names the flow defines. MDL-LISTOP01 did it for a filter/find predicate only, and MDL063 collects definitions for duplicates, so both halves existed and were never joined for ordinary expression slots.
insight: **The risky half of an undefined-variable rule is the implicit names, and the answer is a measurement, not a list from memory.** One `mx check -j` over 55 flows (11 candidate names x plain flow, loop body, error handler, filter predicate, after a loop) on MxBuild 11.16.1: $currentUser, $currentSession, $latestError, $latestHttpResponse and $latestSoapFault are accepted in EVERY position (even $latestError in a flow with no handler); $currentIndex and the loop iterator only inside the loop; $currentObject only inside a filter predicate; $latestJavaException and a made-up $IteratorItem are CE0109 like $Nope; the iterator after its loop is CE0108. The rule treats $currentIndex and $currentObject as defined everywhere, stricter than MxBuild on purpose: a missed report costs less than a false one, because exec refuses what check reports. Producers come from FlowDefinedVariables (params plus every statement's declare/create/retrieve/OutputVariable at any depth); a read of the AST for fields that look like producers found none missed (ExternalObjectStmt.Variable is consumed). Names compare case-insensitively since whether Mendix distinguishes $count from $Count is unmeasured. Sweep of every .mdl in the repo (1658 flows): 3 hits, all correct: the f05 fixture and two negative tests (bug-tests/ledger-17 and ledger-21 .fail.mdl) that `set $Bad = …` without declaring it and then `return $Bad`. Control: stubbing the check fails all 11 positive cases and the @excluded control.
